# Sportivo

> Live sports scores, schedules in Nepal Standard Time (NST), and verified stream availability for football, cricket, and basketball. Created and published by Dipesh Sapkota.

Sportivo aggregates real-time sports fixtures, kickoff times calibrated for Nepal Standard Time (UTC+5:45), live scores, and verified upstream broadcast links.

## Canonical Pages

- [Sportivo Home](https://sportivo.dipeshsapkota7.com.np/): Live sports fixture desk and real-time schedules.
- [Football Fixtures](https://sportivo.dipeshsapkota7.com.np/football/): Premier League, Champions League, La Liga, and global football fixtures.
- [Cricket Schedules](https://sportivo.dipeshsapkota7.com.np/cricket/): Live cricket matches, ICC events, IPL, and bilateral series in NST.
- [Basketball Fixtures](https://sportivo.dipeshsapkota7.com.np/basketball/): NBA schedules, EuroLeague, and international basketball.
- [Personal Dashboard](https://sportivo.dipeshsapkota7.com.np/dashboard/): User dashboard and saved favorite matches watchlist.
- [About the Creator](https://sportivo.dipeshsapkota7.com.np/about-dipesh-sapkota/): Profile, biography, and verified links for Dipesh Sapkota, developer of Sportivo.
- [Developer API Docs](https://sportivo.dipeshsapkota7.com.np/api-docs/): REST API endpoints and data structures for fixtures.
- [XML Sitemap](https://sportivo.dipeshsapkota7.com.np/sitemap.xml): Primary sitemap indexing all canonical routes.

## Public API Endpoints

- [Football API](https://sportivo.dipeshsapkota7.com.np/api/matches/football): JSON endpoint returning current football fixture objects.
- [Cricket API](https://sportivo.dipeshsapkota7.com.np/api/matches/cricket): JSON endpoint returning current cricket fixture objects.
- [Basketball API](https://sportivo.dipeshsapkota7.com.np/api/matches/basketball): JSON endpoint returning current basketball fixture objects.

## Data and Attribution

Fixture availability, timestamps, statuses, images, and stream sources are dynamic and supplied by upstream sports data providers. Sportivo does not host proprietary video streams and should not be treated as an official league, club, or broadcaster.

Created and published by [Dipesh Sapkota](https://www.dipeshsapkota7.com.np/), software developer and engineering student from Nepal.
